title: Normative corpus index
description: Declares which documents under system/ bind, which are reasoning, and which have been retired. Lives under system/contracts/ rather than system/schema/ because it governs prose, not stored records — the data contract fingerprints only the record schemas.

corpus_version.description: Bumped when the vocabulary below changes, not when a document is added.

entrypoint.description: The one document every operator enters through. Must be indexed, current and binding.

path.description: Repository-relative path. Every system/*.md and system/adr/*.md file appears exactly once.

class.description: What kind of document this is.

status.description: current = live; superseded = retired whole by a successor; frozen = complete by design and never to change.

authority.description: binding = must be obeyed; informative = creates no obligation; historical = records what was true and is never a current rule.

owner.description: The subject area answerable for this document.

summary.description: One sentence: what a reader gets from this document.

supersedes.description: Documents this one retires WHOLE. Authored on the successor; the reverse link is derived, never stored.

amends.description: Documents this one retires IN PART. Authored on the successor; the reverse link is derived, never stored.
